_comment: Hand-written narrative for nodes in the architecture map. Keyed by node id (typically the file's basename without extension). Merged in by generate-architecture-map.js on every build.

App.plain: Top of the Expo app. Loads fonts and decides which stack to show — onboarding if the user hasn't finished setup, MainTabs if they have.
App.does: Bootstraps the React Native app, sets up navigation container, owns RootStackParamList.

MainTabs.plain: The bottom 5-tab bar shown after onboarding: Discover, Meal Plan, Scan, Shop, Profile.
MainTabs.does: Defines TabId union and renders the main tab navigator.

DietProtocolScreen.plain: User picks one of 8 diet protocols. This is the single most load-bearing answer in onboarding — it drives every downstream filter.

DiscoverScreen.plain: The home tab. Shows recipe cards filtered by the user's diet and preferences.
DiscoverScreen.does: Fetches recipes, applies diet filter, renders cards.

ScanScreen.plain: Camera tab. Snap a recipe page or pantry photo; Gemini extracts ingredients.

ShopScreen.plain: The shopping list. Consolidates ingredients from planned meals into a deduped list with categories.
ShopScreen.does: Reads MenuContext, parses ingredients, groups by SHOPPING_CATEGORIES.

RecipeDetailScreen.plain: Full recipe view. Shows ingredients with diet swaps applied based on user's protocol.
RecipeDetailScreen.does: Loads recipe, applies applyDietSwap for each non-compliant ingredient.

ReviewQueueScreen.plain: Where Rafi swipes through scraped recipes and approves/rejects them. Approval triggers onRecipeApproved cloud fn.
ReviewQueueScreen.does: Lists pending recipes, calls resolveReviewItem on swipe.

NeedsReviewScreen.plain: Shows recipes the enrichment pipeline flagged as uncertain — usually diet-tag conflicts or unmatched ingredients.

DecisionsCatalogScreen.plain: Audit log of every diet-tag override Rafi has made. The 'decisions' collection is the source of truth when human and rule disagree.

DietTag.plain: The circular diet badge. Solid fill = native to the recipe, dashed border = modified via swap. Never pill-shaped.

PremiumGate.plain: Wraps premium-tier features. Shows upgrade CTA if user is on the free plan.

firestore.plain: Every read/write to Firestore goes through this file. Exports fetchCatalogRecipes, fetchRecipesByIds, subscribeCatalogRecipes, updateRecipeStatus, etc.
firestore.does: Wraps Firestore SDK calls; converts docs → typed Recipe objects.

firebase.plain: Initializes the Firebase app + Firestore + Auth instances. Web vs native config split happens here.

gemini.plain: Sends photos to Google Gemini for ingredient extraction. Used by Scan tab.

claudeScoring.plain: Asks Claude to score whether an ingredient is compliant with a given diet protocol. Fallback when the rules engine is unsure.

ingredientParser.plain: The workhorse for shopping list. Parses '2 tbsp olive oil, divided' into { name, qty, unit, raw, category }.
ingredientParser.does: Exports parseIngredient, normalizeIngredient, fmtQty, SHOPPING_CATEGORIES, categorizeIngredientWithMatch.

bugs.txt: Fuzzy matcher occasionally returns false positives for short ingredient names (e.g. 'salt' matches 'sea salt').
Unicode whitespace in chef notes was joining sentences without spaces — fixed in classifyDietTags (commit 43104ab). Verify parser handles same chars on input.

fixes: Tighten fuzzyMatch threshold for tokens ≤ 4 chars
Add a unit test fixture covering 50 known-problem ingredients

dietSwaps.plain: Looks up the right substitution for a non-compliant ingredient given the user's diet. Backed by masterSwapTable.json.

bugs.txt: Generic 'herbs' substituted for warm spices (cinnamon, clove) — per Rafi's rules, swaps must match by function.

fixes: Add functional-category metadata to masterSwapTable rows and bias swap selection toward same category.

UserContext.plain: Holds the logged-in user, their diet protocol, household size, protein/cuisine prefs, and subscription tier. Read by almost every screen.

MenuContext.plain: Holds the user's current meal plan — which recipes they've added, servings, organic preference. The shopping list reads from here.

classifyDietTags.plain: Applies the 8-protocol rule set + Claude fallback to a recipe's ingredients and writes dietTags (short codes: DF, GF, LF, K…) with notes-array + notesText.

bugs.txt: Joined chef notes were missing spaces between sentences when unicode whitespace appeared — fixed in commit 43104ab (dedupe joinSentences + normalize unicode whitespace).

fixes: Add regression test for unicode-whitespace inputs.

onRecipeApproved.plain: Fires whenever a recipe is approved in the review queue. Kicks off enrichment: diet classification, protein classification, description fetch.

recipes_collection.plain: ~1078 enriched recipes, the heart of the product. Each doc has ingredients, dietTags, dietTagsNotes, nutrition.byDiet, status, etc.

decisions_collection.plain: Per-recipe override doc. When Rafi disagrees with the rule engine, the override lives here. Wins over computed tags.
